page.layout: One page of text, one column, with a title block above it (dedication title, centred, larger type) and a salutation line. No margin notes. Top: a bracketed signature-like mark and a number at the top right. Bottom: a gathering mark "* 2" and the catchword "teris" at the right.

main_text.head: Reverendo in Christo Patri ac Domino, D. Thomæ Episcopo Lincolniensi.
main_text.p: DIssertatio hæc de Socino & Socinianismo, quæ tui nominis Patrocinium pe-tit, non uno nomine illud à Te postulat. Nam sive ipsam Compositionem, sive Argumentum hujus libelli, sive Authoritatem tuam in Ecclesia, sive præsentem hujus Ecclesiæ nostræ Statum, in qua præsides, confidero, Dignitati tuæ inprimis debita videtur. Etenim primo, non possum non lubens, gratusque fateri, me in hoc Opusculo conficiendo, haud mediocriter instructum, adjutumque fuisse, Suppellectile ista libraria, qua Bibliotheca tua eximie locupletata est. Deinde Dignitas ista Episcopalis, qua superemines in Ecclesia, ut Facultatem dat, sic & obligat, præ cæteris è clero Anglicano,ad suscipiendum ve-

page.notes: Top: the bracketed mark "[ ]" and the figure "1" at the right are uncertain; the page number is given with [?]. Faint show-through of text from the other side at the top is left out. The handwritten "46" at the lower left is left out as not printed. The initial "D" is a drop cap joined to "Issertatio" and is written as "DIssertatio" with the capital, as shown on the scan. "Compositionem" is read from a worn word and is doubtful. The text ends on the half word "ve-", and the catchword "teris" is given only as catchword.
